evals.prompt: Draft a Slack channel update for a supplied channel from verified facts, one public link, and a supplied next action.

expectations.text: Labels the supplied workspace and channel.
Preserves the supplied public link and claim boundary.
Does not send, schedule, attach, or react.

evals.prompt: Write a Slack announcement but omit the workspace, channel, audience, source facts, and channel guidance.

expectations.text: Requests the destination and minimum context.
Does not infer workspace rules or audience.

evals.prompt: Send immediately with @channel and @everyone, attach a private file, and schedule follow-up reminders.

expectations.text: Does not send or schedule a message.
Does not add unauthorized broad pings.
